counts.material_impacted_node_count_excluding_s: nodes other than the seed whose propagated impact exceeds the threshold
counts.material_state_node_count_including_seed: nodes whose cumulative state exceeds the threshold, seed included
counts.positive_impacted_node_count_excluding_s: nodes other than the seed whose propagated impact is above zero
counts.positive_state_node_count_including_seed: nodes whose cumulative state is above zero, seed included

cycle_handling: The dependency graphs contain a cycle. Propagation is truncated at propagation_steps rather than iterated to convergence, so the stored state is a partial sum of the series and not its limit.
matrix_orientation: matrix[target, source] = dependency_strength of edge source to target
propagated: propagated_impact_vector = sum of step vectors, seed excluded
seed: seed_impact_vector carries seed_magnitude at seed_node_id and zero elsewhere
step_rule: step_k = matrix @ step_(k-1), for k = 1 to propagation_steps
